name: gods-eye-view
description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
one_liner: A browser app that shows a realistic 3D globe with live planes, ships, satellites, earthquakes, and public cameras, like a real-time spy-movie map of the world.
buyer: A news organization's graphics desk that needs a live, explorable visual of world events (flights, shipping, disasters) for breaking-news broadcasts without building mapping tech in-house.
business_use_cases: A TV news channel embeds a branded version to show live flight-tracking or shipping-lane disruptions during a breaking-news segment.
A logistics company uses the ship and traffic layers as a public-facing dashboard to show customers real-time shipment visibility.
A YouTuber or streamer builds a paid course or subscription channel narrating live world events using the tool as their visual backdrop.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, white-labeled version for newsrooms and streamers with a branding removal fee.
Sell premium data layers (higher-resolution imagery, historical playback) as an add-on.

steal_this: Clone it, strip it down to just live flights + ships for one city/region, and sell it as an embeddable widget to local news sites this weekend.
